name: @tejoma/matching-evaluation-service
description: Tejoma Matching Evaluation Service - Tier 0 (Batch 24, first slice of the Matching domain). Owns ranking evaluation (NDCG/MAP/MRR/Precision/Recall over real swipe history) and Learning-to-Rank training - match_evaluation_runs and ltr_model_versions. Proxies to the monolith for swipe/candidate/job data and the live scoring engine's feature vectors, neither of which this service owns. shadowDataHealth/proficiencyAnalytics/bgeShadowRetrieval stay on the monolith (deeper coupling to the swipe-triggered shadow-write path - see README.md).
